name: bld3_sq_card_le_sum_mul_sum_inv
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → K) (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < a i) : (s.card : K) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, a i) * ∑ i ∈ s, (a i)⁻¹
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] (ι : Type*) (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → K) (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < a i), (s.card : K) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, a i) * ∑ i ∈ s, (a i)⁻¹
informal: Uses Mathlib2.gen_an_amgm_finset_ordered_ring and Mathlib2.bld2_card_le_sum_of_prod_eq_one: AM-GM for a and for a⁻¹ gives n^n ∏ a ≤ (∑ a)^n and n^n ∏ a⁻¹ ≤ (∑ a⁻¹)^n; multiply (the products cancel) to get (n^2)^n ≤ ((∑ a)(∑ a⁻¹))^n and take n-th roots by monotonicity of powers.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] (ι : Type u_2) (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → K), (∀ i ∈ s, 0 < a i) → ↑s.card ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, a i) * ∑ i ∈ s, (a i)⁻¹
